name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
title: Kuantum Papers Ltd - 532937 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin rose to 15.9% on NSR of INR3,700/t, but management admits price hikes partly reversed in May and PM3 upgrade slipped; FY27 guided lower revenue of INR1,400-1,500 crore.

utilisation.quote: if we talk of the OE levels, so they are above 92%, and this is post expansion of all the 3 machines

capex.quote: So, we have to defer the upgradation.

triggers.label: OE utilisation above 92%
triggers.quote: the OE levels, so they are above 92%

triggers.label: Price hike partly reversed in May
triggers.quote: we've had to return the price increase and fall back on a reduction

triggers.label: PM3 upgrade deferred on German parts
triggers.quote: So, we have to defer the upgradation.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue INR1,400-1,500 cr
triggers.quote: FY27, it will be like about INR1,400 crores to INR 1,500 crores

guidance.quote: We should be manufacturing and selling about 2,30,000 tons.
FY27, it will be like about INR1,400 crores to INR 1,500 crores
we should try and touch about between 18% to 20% EBITDA
the peak debt will be in between 650 to 675 by end of 2027
we look forward at around 5% to 8% of total cost of manufacturing coming down

prior_guidance_check.quote: it has been delayed a bit because of the global crisis

red_flags.label: Debt high vs peers; INR720 crore LT debt; 8.5% cost of funds
red_flags.quote: as on 31st March, we have a long-term debt of INR720 crores

red_flags.label: Volume ramp to 2.3 lakh t depends on absorbing new capacity
red_flags.quote: we are intending to utilize more than 90% of the capacity as and how it comes on stream

red_flags.label: Tissue project deferred
red_flags.quote: The plan for tissue project only stands deferred. It's not shelved.

evasions.topic: Pricing outlook / realisation growth from anti-subsidy duty
evasions.quote: I won't be able to comment on how much increased realization will happen

evasions.topic: Wood social forestry share of procurement
evasions.quote: really coming on to that percentage is a bit difficult
